source_label: In Puget Sound and approaches in Haro Strait, Boundary Pass and in the Strait of Georgia
official_name: In Puget Sound and its approaches in Haro Strait, Boundary Pass and in the Strait of Georgia

tss_identity: Confirmed

IMO name as amended by COLREG.2/Circ.55 (MSC 79, 15 December 2004; amendments implemented 1 July 2005). US statutory text splits it into 33 CFR 167.1320-1323 (Puget Sound and its approaches) and 167.1330-1332 (Haro Strait, Boundary Pass, Strait of Georgia). Grouped heading; the separate Strait of Juan de Fuca and approaches schemes (33 CFR 167.1300/1310) are not part of this label.
vts: Victoria Traffic (CCG MCTS Victoria, Victoria VTS Zone)

US parts: 33 CFR 161.55 defines the VTS Puget Sound area as US navigable waters of the Salish Sea to the US/Canada boundary, and Table 161.12(c) assigns Seattle Traffic Ch 14 (Puget Sound) and Ch 5A (US Salish Sea incl. Rosario Strait and US side of Haro Strait). Canadian parts: CCG RAMN 2026 Table 3-1 places Canadian waters through Haro Strait, Boundary Pass and the Strait of Georgia in Victoria VTS Zone Sector 1 (Victoria Traffic Ch 11). Both operate within the US/Canadian CVTS; the CVTS northern limit is 49°N, so the Strait of Georgia component north of 49°N is a Canadian-only VTS area.
reporting: Unresolved

No IMO-adopted (SOLAS V/11) mandatory ship reporting system found for this area. 33 CFR 161 VMRS reporting (sailing plans, position and final reports) applies, but it is the ordinary participation duty of the VTS and is recorded with the service, not as a separate reporting system. A failed search does not establish absence. Canadian side: Vessel Traffic Services Zones Regulations (SOR/2025-275, replacing SOR/89-98) require sailing plans, including a 24-hour report when entering from outside Canadian waters; again VTS participation reporting.

Not applicable to the Narragansett approach. WHALESNORTH does not extend this far west.

New scheme adopted by MSC 91 and circulated as COLREG.2/Circ.64 (2012), implemented 1 August 2013, per Transportstyrelsen list (S4); associated precautionary areas in SN.1/Circ.317 (S4). Separate IMO deep-water route leading to IJmuiden listed in Ships' Routeing 2008 (S27). Circ.64 text not retrieved.
vts: VTS North Sea Canal Area (IJmuiden Approaches / Sector IJmuiden)

VTS North Sea Canal Area covers 'the approaches to IJmuiden ... within a 12-nautical-mile radius ... including the extended IJ-geul deep water channel' (S12). The source does not state that the TSS lanes lie within this area; the extended IJ-geul is a separate IMO deep-water route. VTS named as a strong lead; overlap with the TSS needs chart verification.
reporting: Unresolved

No IMO or national mandatory reporting system specific to the TSS found. Within the VTS area there are ordinary VTS reporting duties: report on arrival at 12 nm to Sector IJmuiden VHF 61 and to IJmuiden Approaches VHF 07 'as soon as VHF contact is possible' (S12). These are VTS reporting duties, recorded separately.
